title: My heart of good intentions
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y1 lesson 15 (Pupil PDF worksheet: my heart of good intentions)
intro: Lesson 15: Ikhlas: actions are by intentions. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: What is in my heart?
points: Niyyah is what we mean inside
Allah knows what is in every heart
Good intention: I do it for Allah

cards: I help Grandma because Allah loves it
I pray only when people watch
I share my snack to make my friend happy
I give so everyone says I am the best
blocks.title: Sort into: For Allah / To show off
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: For Allah, To show off.
blocks.answer: For Allah: I help Grandma because Allah loves it; I share my snack to make my friend happy. To show off: I pray only when people watch; I give so everyone says I am the best

box.title: Draw a big heart. Inside, write one good deed and the words 'for Allah'.

keywords.def: what we mean in our heart
a good gift from Allah for good deeds
doing something only so people praise us

questions.q: Give a good intention for brushing your teeth.
questions.a: For example: to stay clean, as the Prophet ﷺ liked

questions.q: Doing good only for Allah is called ...
Draw a heart on the pupil PDF and write one good deed inside with 'for Allah'.
questions.a: For example: I help Mum for Allah.

questions.q: Extend: say the hadith 'Actions are only by intentions'.
Stretch: can sleeping be rewarded? How?
questions.a: Yes, if we sleep to be strong for Fajr and to obey Allah.
A) In the heart. Niyyah is in the heart; Allah knows it.

questions.q: Think again: which child gets reward from Allah?
questions.a: The one who tidied to please Allah.
